slides.notes: THE SLIDE FOR THE MAIN DECK. Title: project name and the result in a few words, 45 characters or fewer. Subtitle: client (or sector), practice, PM, dates. Practice: the official IG practice name. Team size: peak FTE, with onshore / offshore split. Project length: months, with start and end month. ACV: annual contract value. TCV: total contract value over the full term; for a flat contract ACV x years = TCV. Customer Problem: the client's pain in their terms, ideally with a number. Scope: what is in, and at least one thing that is out. Technologies: up to 6 named platforms, languages or tools, one per tag. How We Found the Need: what triggered it, how discovery was done, who approved it. Deal of Delivery (DOD): whether one was created and when, what it commits to, who agreed it and where it is kept; write 'Not created' if there is none. Outcomes: optional; measured results so far, or delete the card's text and write 'In progress'.
